props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. The schema is read through it, once per page.

props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: The type every path starts on.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The chosen dotted paths, in the order they are shown.

props.name: on_value_change
props.meaning: Receives the new array on every add, remove and move.

props.name: layout
props.meaning: `list` is the field picker over the ordered list; `dual` is the two lists side by side.

props.name: show_count
props.meaning: Show how many columns are chosen under the list.

props.name: deep_links
props.meaning: Allow descending through entity fields.

props.name: max_depth
props.meaning: How many hops a path may take.

props.name: data_types
props.meaning: Data types a field must have to be selected.

props.name: valid_types
props.meaning: A field is selectable only if it links one of these.

props.name: exclude
props.meaning: Full dotted paths to drop.

props.name: hide_paths
props.meaning: Dotted prefixes to drop, along with everything beneath them.

props.name: filterable_only
props.meaning: Drop the data types the API refuses in a filter.

props.name: extra_fields
props.meaning: Synthetic entries offered at the root only.

props.name: filter
props.meaning: Your own visibility test over the schema and the candidate's full path.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Placeholder of the field picker.

props.name: search_placeholder
props.meaning: Shown in the search box.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown while no column is chosen.

props.name: no_match_label
props.meaning: Shown when the search over the fields on offer matches nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: available_label
props.meaning: Heading of the left list, `dual` only.

props.name: chosen_label
props.meaning: Heading of the right list, `dual` only.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Shows the chosen list alone, with no controls.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Puts the invalid ring on the field picker, or on both lists under `dual`.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Row height.

events.name: value_changed
events.when: A column is added, removed or moved.

keyboard.does: Add the field under the cursor. A link that cannot be chosen descends instead.
Descend into the link under the cursor.
Moves through the picker, then the grip and remove button of each chosen row.
Picks the row up for the arrow keys.
Put it back where it was.
Move the chosen row holding focus one place earlier.
